title: Console: a server-ended session is re-checked twice — the 401 burst of one navigation is not collapsed to one get-session read
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Kind: product defect (low severity)

Subject: objectstack main a557fa386bc3, console built from this tree (`pnpm console:build`), stock showcase `os dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch` on its own port + file DB.

Repro (reproduced 3 times, fresh browser context each, Playwright, role/label-targeted clicks):
1. Sign in through the console form as admin@objectos.ai / admin123; open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/record/‹id›`.
2. From a second client signed in as the same admin: `POST /api/v1/auth/revoke-other-sessions` → 200 `{"status":true}`.
3. In the tab, click the sidebar entry "Projects" (no reload).
Expected (AuthProvider.tsx's own comment, and identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session acceptance[2]): "A burst of `401`s from one navigation collapses to one read" — the console sends ONE `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session`, then goes to `/login?redirect=…`.
Actual: two get-session reads, both 401, ~10 ms apart, before the tab moves to `/_console/login?redirect=%2Fapps%2Fcom.example.showcase%2Fshowcase_project` (the end state is correct). Trace (run 1): +333ms 401 GET sys_personal_view → +334 REQ get-session → +335 401 showcase_project?top=0 → +366 401 get-session → +366 REQ get-session → +371 401 showcase_project?populate=… → +375 401 get-session → +393 NAV /login?redirect=…

Mechanism: `ui/packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx:308-322` — the sessionEndEvents subscriber sets `sessionEndCheckInFlight.current = true`, awaits `client.getSession()`, schedules `setUser(null)`/`setSession(null)` on a "no session" answer, then clears the flag in `finally`. The subscription is only torn down when the effect re-runs on `holdsSession` turning false, i.e. after React commits. A 401 from the same navigation that lands between the flag clear and that commit passes the guard (`if (sessionEndCheckInFlight.current || sessionLoadInFlight.current) return;`, line 309) and fires a second read. Fix shape: leave the flag set (or mark the subscription cancelled) once a read has ended the session, so later 401s of the same burst are dropped.

Impact: one redundant request per server-ended session; no wrong state reached. Not a regression (the session-end code path did not change after 181ad7d4; the one commit touching AuthProvider.tsx since, 4dbcbddd8, edits the direct-sign-in part). The unit pins (ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx 20/20, createAuthenticatedFetch.test.tsx 19/19) do not assert a get-session call count across a multi-401 burst.

Duplicates searched (gh api search/issues, repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open): "sessionEndCheckInFlight" → 0; "get-session burst 401" → 4, all [PM seat] cards, none related; "session ended re-check get-session" → 11, all [PM seat] cards, none related.

QA-source: #33853 · identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session · acceptance[2]
